evals_reused_note: Origin ships no evals/ directory. Authored fresh from the origin SKILL.md's 5-step workflow (identify claims, search authoritative sources, compare with status codes, generate a correction report, apply only with user approval).
live_dependency_note: Genuinely needs live web search to verify current facts (model specs, version numbers) — same tension as bilibili-source. Resolution: same technique as bilibili-source's meta.json — expectations grade methodology fidelity (searched official sources, correctly classified factual vs. subjective content, cited a source, asked before applying corrections, distinguished outdated-but-was-true from simply-incorrect) rather than requiring a specific frozen 'correct' answer, since sound process naturally converges on whatever is currently true. Flagged live=true for the same rep-count-capping treatment in Phase 3's harness.
